categories.main_business_segments: Chenguang Biotech Group primarily operates in the natural plant extraction industry, focusing on six main product series: natural pigments, natural spice extracts and essential oils, natural nutritional and medicinal extracts, natural sweeteners, health foods, and oils and proteins. The company also engages in cottonseed-related businesses including processing and sales of cottonseed products. Additionally, it has subsidiaries involved in agricultural planting and pharmaceutical production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced extraction technologies such as ultrasonic extraction, low-temperature extraction, crystallization and chromatographic separation, supercritical CO2 extraction, subcritical extraction, and microencapsulation. It has developed proprietary equipment tailored to its production processes, enabling high yield and cost efficiency. The R&D approach follows a 'small test + pilot test + scale-up + industrial production' model, emphasizing continuous innovation and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chenguang Biotech serves downstream industries including food and beverage, seasoning, pharmaceuticals, health supplements, cosmetics, and animal feed additives. Its products are widely used for coloring, flavoring, nutrition, and medicinal purposes. The company’s customers include well-known enterprises in these sectors both domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases and sales networks nationwide. It also has international operations and sourcing in India, Zambia, Myanmar, the United States, Hong Kong, and other regions. Its products are exported globally to Europe, Asia, Southeast Asia, the Americas, Oceania, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chenguang Biotech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on extraction, processing, and product manufacturing. It also extends upstream by establishing raw material planting bases through cooperative planting and self-cultivation in key agricultural regions domestically and abroad, ensuring stable raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a world-leading natural extraction base with ten or more products ranked first or among the top globally. It prioritizes large-scale R&D investment in process technology, new product development, efficacy research, and resource utilization. It aims to expand into health foods, traditional Chinese medicine, and nutritional supplements, leveraging scientific innovation and digital transformation including AI applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of natural plant extracts, health foods, oils, proteins, and cottonseed products. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors and agents, with a small but growing online direct sales channel. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chenguang Biotech is the largest listed company in China’s plant extraction industry and ranks among the global top tier, competing with international leaders like Frutarom, Kalsec, Synthite, and Lycored. It holds world-leading positions in key products such as capsanthin, capsicum oleoresin, and lutein, and is rapidly advancing in other product lines.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 6.99 billion, a slight increase of 1.79% year-over-year, but net profit attributable to shareholders declined sharply by over 80% to RMB 94 million due to raw material price volatility and asset impairment in cottonseed business. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 9 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chenguang Biotech emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective, and stable supply of natural plant extracts with advanced proprietary technologies and industrialized production. Its comprehensive product portfolio and strong R&D capabilities enable customized and differentiated products. The company’s integrated supply chain and global raw material sourcing provide competitive cost advantages and product consistency, supporting its leadership in the natural extraction market.
